title: ROS 2 logging
keywords: log logging logger rosout debug info warn error fatal log-level console
text: Every node logs at the levels DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR and FATAL to the console, to the /rosout topic and to files under ~/.ros/log. --ros-args --log-level debug raises the detail for one run (a logger name can be given too). ros2 topic echo /rosout shows the logs of all nodes on the domain. Incompatible QoS between a publisher and a subscriber is reported as a warning in the logs of the nodes involved.
